items.title: Unauthenticated Remote Code Execution (RCE) via StyleSmuggler
items.summary: A critical zero-day vulnerability allowing unauthenticated attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source installations. Actively exploited in the wild.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source
items.summary: This update resolves critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities that could lead to arbitrary code execution, privilege escalation, and security feature bypass. Adobe is not aware of any exploits in the wild for these issues.

items.title: Remote Code Execution (RCE) vulnerability
items.summary: Described as the 'worst bug to hit Magento and Adobe Commerce stores in two years,' this vulnerability is under active exploitation, with stores being compromised at a high rate.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source
items.summary: This update addresses multiple vulnerabilities, including a critical incorrect authorization flaw (CVE-2026-71362) that could lead to unauthenticated remote code execution and privilege escalation.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization leading to Elevated Access
items.summary: A critical vulnerability that could be leveraged to gain elevated access to sensitive resources without authentication.

items.title: Remote Code Execution (RCE) via Unrestricted File Upload
items.summary: A critical vulnerability in Adobe Commerce caused by unrestricted file upload with dangerous types, allowing attackers to execute arbitrary code by uploading malicious files.

items.title: Stored Cross-Site Scripting (XSS)
items.summary: A high-severity stored cross-site scripting vulnerability that could result in arbitrary code execution, requiring authentication but not administrator privileges.

items.title: Stored Cross-Site Scripting (XSS)
items.summary: A high-severity stored cross-site scripting vulnerability that could result in arbitrary code execution, requiring authentication and administrator privileges.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization (Security-Feature Bypass)
items.summary: A high-severity incorrect-authorization vulnerability affecting Adobe Commerce B2B that could enable a security-feature bypass, requiring authentication but not administrator privileges.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization (Security-Feature Bypass)
items.summary: A high-severity incorrect-authorization vulnerability that could enable a security-feature bypass, requiring neither authentication nor administrator privileges.

items.title: Unauthenticated Arbitrary File Upload in Amasty Order Attributes
items.summary: An unauthenticated arbitrary file upload flaw in Amasty Order Attributes allows attackers to write executable files to a Magento store without logging in, leading to remote code execution.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source
items.summary: This bulletin addresses critical and important vulnerabilities, including CVE-2026-48356, that could lead to arbitrary code execution, security feature bypass, arbitrary file system read, and application denial-of-service.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source
items.summary: This update resolves critical and important vulnerabilities that could lead to security feature bypass, privilege escalation, arbitrary file system read, and application denial-of-service.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization (Security-Feature Bypass)
items.summary: A medium-severity incorrect-authorization vulnerability that could enable a security-feature bypass, requiring authentication and administrator privileges.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization (Privilege Escalation)
items.summary: A low-severity incorrect-authorization vulnerability that could result in privilege escalation, requiring authentication and administrator privileges.
